name: codegraph
description: Pre-indexed code knowledge graph, auto syncs on code changes, for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode, AntiGravity, Kiro, CoPilot, and Hermes Agent — fewer tokens, fewer tool calls, 100% local
one_liner: A tool that builds a map of how all the pieces of a codebase connect, so an AI coding assistant can understand a project instantly instead of guessing from scratch every time.
buyer: A new engineering hire, or anyone working in a large unfamiliar codebase, who wants faster and cheaper AI coding answers.
business_use_cases: A new engineer joining a company with a sprawling codebase uses it so their AI assistant can answer 'where is X handled' instantly instead of searching manually.
A dev agency uses it across all client codebases to cut the token cost of every AI coding session, since accurate context means fewer wasted tool calls.
A due-diligence firm evaluating a startup's codebase for acquisition uses it to quickly generate an architecture overview without reading every file.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, managed version with a simple web UI for non-technical stakeholders like due-diligence teams to explore a codebase's architecture, sold per audit.

steal_this: This weekend, offer a 'codebase onboarding map' service: run it against a client's repo and deliver a one-page architecture diagram plus AI-queryable index for a flat fee.
